items.transcript: As a mum of four, I always make sure everyone else is okay before I even think about myself. And that even comes down to my own health. I was having a look and I found the Do Health app. I booked in for one of their blood tests because we know what it's like when you don't feel yourself and you just google your symptoms and then you think worst case scenario. I wanted to properly understand my own health. A blood test came back in about two days and I was so surprised by my own results. Starting off, my biological age is 25. In my head, I thought it was going to be up in the 60s. So honestly, that was very reassuring. Obviously, I have some things that I need to work on. Vitamin D is low, my B12 is low, my calcium is low and I had inflammation markers as well. But what I love most about this app is that it breaks everything down for you. Because we know what it's like when you go to the doctors and you have no idea what any of it means. This literally explains it in the most simple terms ever. App also gives you weekly challenges on how to better your health and is very realistic even if you've got children. So I'm going to be making small changes, changing my diet, making the absolute most out of the sun. And you best bet I just booked a holiday as well. I'm going to try and sleep better as well. But we know what that's like with a 10 month old. I'm going to try and do less screen time. It's all small things but they all add up. I'm looking forward for three months time when I get my blood work done again. But now it's time to think about myself a little bit more now as much as I possibly can of course with four kids. And if you want to join in too, check out the caption below to know what's actually going on inside.
